# Fileora

> Fileora is a free website of PDF and image tools for students, job seekers and small businesses, mainly in India. Free tools run entirely in the browser, so files are never uploaded. Pro (₹99/month, ₹799/year or ₹29 day pass; $4.99/$39/$1.99 outside India) unlocks PDF to Word, AI background removal, OCR and resume PDF downloads.

## Tools

- [JPG to PDF](https://fileora.com/tools/jpg-to-pdf.html): To convert JPG to PDF, add your images, put them in order, pick a page size like A4 and tap Convert. Fileora builds the PDF inside your browser in about a second, with no upload, no watermark and no sign-up. It also accepts PNG, WebP and iPhone HEIC photos. (Free)
- [Compress Image](https://fileora.com/tools/compress-image.html): To compress an image to a specific size, add your photo, choose a target like 50KB or 100KB and tap Compress. Fileora lowers the JPG quality step by step until the file fits, and only shrinks the dimensions if it has to. It is free, works on phones and never uploads your photo. (Free)
- [PDF to JPG](https://fileora.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg.html): To convert a PDF to JPG, drop the PDF here, choose JPG or PNG and a resolution, and every page is turned into an image in your browser. Download single pages or all of them in one ZIP. Fileora is free, has no page limit and never uploads your PDF. (Free)
- [Merge PDF](https://fileora.com/tools/merge-pdf.html): To merge PDF files, add two or more PDFs, drag them into the order you want and tap Merge. Fileora copies every page into one PDF without re-compressing, so quality stays the same. It is free, adds no watermark and the files never leave your device. (Free)
- [Split PDF](https://fileora.com/tools/split-pdf.html): To split a PDF, add the file and type the pages you want, such as 1-3, 5. Each range becomes its own PDF, or tick one-file mode to keep the chosen pages together. You can also split every page into a separate file. Fileora is free and works without uploading. (Free)
- [Resize & Convert Image](https://fileora.com/tools/image-resizer.html): To resize an image, add it, type a new width and height in pixels or pick a percent or preset, choose JPG, PNG or WebP, and tap Resize & convert. Fileora keeps the aspect ratio for you, converts iPhone HEIC photos, and works in the browser without uploading. (Free)
- [GST Invoice Generator](https://fileora.com/tools/gst-invoice-generator.html): To make a GST invoice, enter your business and customer details with GSTIN and state, add items with HSN/SAC, quantity, rate and GST rate, and download the PDF. Fileora applies CGST + SGST for sales within a state and IGST for sales to another state automatically, and shows the total in words. (Free)
- [PDF to Word](https://fileora.com/tools/pdf-to-word.html): To convert PDF to Word, upload the PDF and Fileora rebuilds its text, tables and images as an editable DOCX file that opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs. Everyone gets 2 free conversions a day, and Pro gives unlimited conversions with bigger files. (Pro)
- [AI Background Remover](https://fileora.com/tools/background-remover.html): To remove a background from a photo, upload it and the AI cuts out the person or product automatically, including hair and soft edges. Download a transparent PNG or choose a white background for marketplace listings. Everyone gets 2 free images a day, and Pro adds HD and batch mode. (Pro)
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://fileora.com/tools/image-to-text.html): To copy text from an image, upload a photo, screenshot or scanned page, choose English, Hindi or both, and tap Extract text. Fileora uses OCR (optical character recognition) to turn the picture into editable text you can copy or save. You get 2 free scans a day. (Pro)
- [Simple CV Maker](https://fileora.com/tools/resume-maker.html): To make a resume, fill in your contact details, summary, experience, education and skills, pick a template and colour, and watch the preview update as you type. Download it as an ATS-friendly PDF with real, searchable text. Building and previewing is free and your draft stays in your browser. (Pro)
- [Visual CV Maker](https://fileora.com/tools/visual-resume-maker.html): To make a visual resume, fill in your details, add a photo, pick a layout and colour theme, and the designed resume updates live. Download it as a high-quality PDF or as a one-page personal website you can host for free. Previewing is free; downloads are a small one-time fee or included in Pro. (Pro)
- [Age Calculator](https://fileora.com/tools/age-calculator.html): To calculate your age, enter your date of birth and the date to measure to, which is today by default. The calculator shows your exact age in years, months and days, your total age in months, weeks, days and hours, the weekday you were born, and a countdown to your next birthday. (Free)
- [Word Counter](https://fileora.com/tools/word-counter.html): To count words, paste or type your text in the box. The word counter instantly shows words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs, reading time and speaking time, plus your most repeated words. It works with English, Hindi and other Indian languages, and nothing is uploaded. (Free)
- [QR Code Generator](https://fileora.com/tools/qr-code-generator.html): To make a QR code, choose a type such as link, UPI, WhatsApp or Wi-Fi, fill in the details, and the QR code appears instantly. Pick colours and size, then download it as PNG or SVG. Fileora's QR codes are free, have no watermark and never expire because the data is stored in the code itself. (Free)

## Popular tasks

- [Compress Image to 20KB](https://fileora.com/tools/compress-image-to-20kb.html): Reduce photo or signature size to under 20KB for SSC, UPSC, bank and job forms. Free, instant and private.
- [Compress Image to 50KB](https://fileora.com/tools/compress-image-to-50kb.html): Compress JPG photos to under 50KB for online applications. Free, no sign-up, and your photo stays on your device.
- [Compress Image to 100KB](https://fileora.com/tools/compress-image-to-100kb.html): Compress JPG, PNG or HEIC photos to under 100KB in one click. Free, fast and private.
- [Compress Image to 200KB](https://fileora.com/tools/compress-image-to-200kb.html): Reduce image size to under 200KB while keeping it sharp. Free, no upload, no sign-up.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://fileora.com/tools/heic-to-jpg.html): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG in your browser. Batch convert, free, no upload.
- [WebP to JPG](https://fileora.com/tools/webp-to-jpg.html): Convert WebP images to JPG (or PNG) instantly. Batch convert for free in your browser.
- [PNG to PDF](https://fileora.com/tools/png-to-pdf.html): Convert PNG screenshots and images to PDF free. Reorder pages and download instantly. No upload.
- [UPI QR Code Generator](https://fileora.com/tools/upi-qr-code-generator.html): Create a free UPI payment QR code with your UPI ID, name and an optional fixed amount. Works with GPay, PhonePe, Paytm and BHIM. Download PNG.
- [Passport Size Photo](https://fileora.com/tools/passport-size-photo.html): Resize any photo to passport size (35×45 mm, 413×531 px) for Indian passport, visa and exam forms. Free and private.
